morgan: Heads up — onboarding 52B-PSI into Dedicated pools this week. Need quick sizing across us-west1 / eu-north1 / apac1. Can we baseline H100 vs A100 with q4f16 and q8_0 kernels? Looking for p50/p95 and tok/s per GPU so we can pick GPU counts and concurrency targets.

dev-bench-bot: CI bench finished for model=52B-PSI quant=[q4f16,q8_0] kernels=[fast_attn,int8_opt]. Full results: https://ci.internal/reports/3398765432 (summary below) :white_check_mark:

```
region | gpu_type   | quant   | p50(ms) | p95(ms) | tok/s_per_gpu
us-west1 | H100-80G  | q4f16   | 48      | 220     | 120000
us-west1 | A100-40G  | q4f16   | 86      | 440     | 70000
eu-north1| H100-80G  | q8_0    | 58      | 270     | 105000
apac1    | A100-80G  | q8_0    | 98      | 510     | 60000
```

jia: Quick take — if product SLO is p95 < 300ms for 512-token responses, H100 q4f16 looks safe at low concurrency. A100 numbers push p95 > 400ms for heavy tails.

oliver: Important: these benches were cold-start (no KV cache). Warmup + first-token penalty makes p95 ~ +60-120ms depending on sequence. Did the CI include prefix caching?

dev-bench-bot: Bench run A included cold/no-cache and warm/cache variants. Numbers above = mixed (5% cold). Separate warm-only runs: H100 q4f16 p95 -> 180ms, A100 q4f16 p95 -> 360ms.

tia: From ops perspective, recommend sizing with warm-only baseline and then adding headroom for cold spikes. Autoscale should target queue depth, not just CPU.

jia: Sizing math (rough): 
- target_p95 = 300ms
- avg request length = 512 tokens -> ~512 tokens * 2 passes ~ 1024 token-ops (rough)
- tok/s_per_gpu (use warm numbers) -> H100 ~120k tok/s => ~120k/1024 ≈ 117 reqs/sec-equivalent (512 tok each)
- to keep p95 < 300ms, keep concurrency ~ 2-3 per GPU on H100. On A100 you'd want concurrency 1 or pin to lower q/kernel.

morgan: So recommendations? list out GPUs per region with autoscale headroom.

jia: Proposal (initial Dedicated pool):
- us-west1: 6 x H100-80G (target concurrency 3, expected sustained qps ~ 6*117*3 ≈ 2100 tok-reqs/sec)
- eu-north1: 4 x H100-80G (target concurrency 3)
- apac1: 8 x A100-80G (target concurrency 1-2, because latency worse)
Add 30% burst_headroom for autoscale (fast add policy + prewarmed GPUs).

oliver: Those counts assume even traffic. If traffic is skewed to us-west nights, need per-az buffer. Also consider hetero mix fallback: put cheaper A100 as overflow and route non-latency critical requests there.

morgan: Agree. We should define canary config before scaling production. Can we run a 2-GPU canary in eu-north1 and a 2-GPU canary in us-west1 with traffic ramp to 5%?

tia: I'll author autoscaler snippet for the runbook. Suggest: 
```
autoscaler:
  target_p95_ms: 300
  burst_headroom_pct: 30
  min_replicas: 2
  scale_up_policy: add_replicas: 2 when queue_pct > 25 for 30s
  scale_down_policy: remove_replicas: 1 when ondemand_util < 40% for 3m
```

sre-bot: FYI added incident-watch for canary windows. Alerts: p95 > 350ms, error_rate > 1%.

jia: Action items:
- morgan: open PR with pool counts + fallback routing rules (us-west hot, eu buffer, apac overflow).
- oliver: run cold/warm KV bench with 10% cold and post raw logs.
- tia: add autoscaler config to playbook and prewarm steps.
- dev-bench-bot: schedule another run with steady-state 60m and 95th noise injection.

morgan: Sounds good. I'll spin up the canaries tomorrow 09:00 PT and tag folks. Thanks everyone :rocket:
